The full integration suite has now finished and passed: exit 0, 268/268 test files, 2553 tests passed and 1 skipped. The run took from 08:29Z to about 09:11Z under load average 15–19, so it ended past the roughly two-hour limit. The 08:59Z snapshot in my previous summary was taken mid-run.

Among the passing files are the contract test (81, including my exercises and the `[390, 389, 1]` media-type pin), my assessments (15) and S16-021 group (1) tests, and both coverage tests after `0088`. My changes add 16 integration tests and one `it` in the contract test.

Acceptance item 3 is met. I've updated §3.3 and the checks table in the handback with these results.

Item 2 is still not met: `pnpm test` exited 1 in both locales. The failures are timeouts under load in files I didn't touch (`architecture.test.ts`, `pdf.test.ts`, and the web `raid.test.tsx`), and they pass when run on their own. A run on a quieter machine is still needed.

The `form_record_type` decision for the procedures coverage view is unchanged: that view still shows the 28 elements as "Planned", and changing it is outside §H.4. All changes are left uncommitted.
